A_baseline.description: original silver_standard + ML trained on it

B_silver_only_enriched.description: audited gold overlaid on silver, OLD ML (no retrain)

C_silver_and_ml_retrained.description: audited gold overlaid + ML retrained on enriched silver
C_silver_and_ml_retrained.delta_vs_B: +0.0 pp coverage (no further coverage gain from ML retrain), +3.7 pp recovery

conclusion: Silver enrichment is NOT a discovery lever — cascade does not fill NEW cells when given richer training labels. But it IS a recovery QUALITY lever — recovery accuracy improves +3.4 pp when silver is enriched AND ML is retrained. Trade-off: would couple ML training with Opus-derived values, weakening the independent-evaluation methodology of §6.14.7.1. Decision: do NOT roll out Opus enrichment across 5 other domains as a coverage strategy; if recovery quality is the goal, evaluate the methodological trade-off explicitly.
